TYPE CHECK: The candidate value "HeLa" is a valid cell line name.
SOURCE CHECK: The paper mentions HeLa cells in the context of mRNA export assays (FISH and RT-qPCR), but the proteomics analysis was performed using "API5 knockout cells" (generated via CRISPR/Cas9) into which FLAG-tagged API5 WT or 4Mut were reconstituted. COMPLETENESS CHECK: The full set contains only "HeLa," which is the likely parent line for the knockout cells used in the MS experiment.
